agent_explanation: Emergency preemption immediately forces direction switch without enforcing all-red clearance or yellow duration. At step 125 EW is green, at step 126 emergency on N becomes active and EW is forced to yellow, then at step 127 NS is forced to green after only 1s of yellow (need 6s) and 0s of all-red (need 4s). Removing the emergency eliminates the violation, confirming emergency handling bypasses clearance timing.
